# Print info about a dggs object to the screen

dggs objects have many settings. This returns all of them, along with
info about the grid being specified.

## Usage

``` r
dginfo(dggs)
```

## Arguments

- dggs:

  A dggs object from dgconstruct()

## Value

No return. All info is printed to the screen.

## Examples

``` r
library(dggridR)
dggs <- dgconstruct(res=20)
dginfo(dggs)
```
